'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**[[Allied Democratic Forces]] [[militant]]s kill at least 25 people in [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. Local officials say most of the victims were [[agriculture in the Democratic Republic of the Congo|farmers]] working in the fields, and that some victims were [[decapitate]]d. [https://www.dw.com/en/dr-congo-rebels-kill-dozens-of-farmers/a-56111863 (DW)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Australia]]n [[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] announces a change, effective January 1, to the wording of the country's [[Advance Australia Fair|national anthem]], in which the word "young" in the second line "For we are young and free" is changed to "one", in an effort to reflect the country's long [[History of Indigenous Australians|indigenous history]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-55494542 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Mining in Papua New Guinea]]
**Two people are confirmed dead and 15 others are feared dead after a [[landslide]] at an informal [[alluvial]] [[mining]] camp in [[Goilala District]], [[Central Province (Papua New Guinea)|Central Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/433867/15-feared-dead-after-landslide-buries-png-village (RNZ)]
*[[Migrants' African routes]]
**The [[Algerian Civil Defence]] says that 20 people were killed and 11 others injured when a vehicle carrying [[Illegal immigration|illegal migrants]] overturned in [[Tamanrasset]]. Tamanrasset is a crossing point for illegal migrants from neighboring countries, specifically [[Mali]] and [[Niger]]. [https://www.channelstv.com/2020/12/31/20-dead-in-algerian-road-accident/ (AFP via Channelstv)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]]
*****A further 20 million people in [[England]] are placed into [[The Health Protection (Coronavirus, Restrictions) (All Tiers) (England) Regulations 2020|Tier 4]], the level with the strictest [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] restrictions. All secondary schools in England are to remain closed for an additional two weeks. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-55489932 (BBC News)]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a record 55,892 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2,488,780. [https://www.itv.com/news/2020-12-31/covid-cases-increase-by-55892-in-another-uk-daily-record-as-death-toll-rises-by-964 (ITV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
****Health officials report that at least 26 residents of a [[retirement home]] in [[Mol, Belgium|Mol]] have died from complications related to COVID-19 since a volunteer dressed as ''[[Sinterklaas]]'', who later tested positive for the virus, visited the home on December 5. Officials, however, have not confirmed that the volunteer was the source of the outbreak at the home, where 85 others have also tested positive. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/26-residents-die-in-belgian-retirement-home-after-visit-by-volunteer-santa (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Czech Republic]] reports a record 16,939 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 718,661 as the positivity rate reaches 52%. [https://www.irozhlas.cz/zpravy-domov/streda-koronavirus-nakazeni-rekord_2012310812_kar (Irozhlas)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports their first case of a [[501.V2 variant|more contagious variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a man who travelled from [[South Africa]] to the [[Haut-Rhin]] region and later tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/france-detects-case-of-south-african-coronavirus-variant (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports a record 7,627 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 413,678. [https://sicnoticias.pt/especiais/coronavirus/2020-12-31-Portugal-com-mais-76-mortes-e-7.627-novos-casos-de-covid-19-nas-ultimas-24-horas (SIC Noticias)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[China]] approves [[BBIBP-CorV]] made by [[Sinopharm]] for general use, after the vaccine was considered to be 79.34% effective. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/30/asia/china-sinopharm-vaccine-efficacy-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
****The [[Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention]] reports their first case of [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|a new variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. The patient is a 23-year-old woman who travelled from the [[United Kingdom]] to [[Shanghai]] on December 14 and later tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20201231-china-confirms-first-case-of-uk-coronavirus-variant (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] receives their second shipment of 1.8 million doses of [[CoronaVac]] from [[Sinovac]]. [https://jakartaglobe.id/news/indonesia-receives-18m-doses-of-sinovac-vaccine-to-immunize-health-workers-in-two-weeks (''Jakarta Globe'')]
****Indonesia also reports a record 7,356 recoveries in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of recoveries to 611,097. [https://www.beritasatu.com/kesehatan/715169/kasus-sembuh-covid19-hari-ini-pecahkan-rekor (Berita Satu)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Tokyo]] reports a record 1,337 new cases in the past 24 hours. It is the first [[Prefectures of Japan|prefecture]] to surpass 1,000 daily cases since the beginning of the pandemic. [http://www.asahi.com/sp/ajw/articles/14073862 (''The Asahi Shimbun'')]
****Nationwide, a record 4,520 new cases are reported in [[Japan]] in the past 24 hours. It is the first time that the country has reported more than 4,000 daily cases since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20201231_20/ (NHK World)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] imposes the highest level of [[social distancing]] measures at prison facilities nationwide. These restrictions will remain in effect until January 13. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201231002051315?section=national/national (Yonhap News Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
****[[Florida]] confirms its first new case of the [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|new variant]] of SARS-CoV-2 that originated in the [[United Kingdom]]. The individual is a [[Martin County, Florida|Martin County]] man with no history of travel. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/532295-florida-detects-first-case-of-new-coronavirus-strain (''The Hill'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] tightens their restrictions as three new cases are reported, bringing the total number of cases in the state to six. Under the new restrictions, in-home gatherings will be limited to 15 people, masks must be worn indoors, and people are advised to stay out of the [[Melbourne city centre]] on New Year's Eve. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2020/dec/31/victoria-mandates-mask-wearing-after-covid-outbreak-rises-to-six-and-nsw-reports-10-new-cases (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] detects their first two cases of [[Variant of Concern 202012/01|a new variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] that originated in the United Kingdom. [https://news.yahoo.com/brazil-detects-two-cases-coronavirus-180946763.html (Reuters via Yahoo! News)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***The [[World Health Organization]] lists the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] [[Tozinameran|vaccine]] for emergency use. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-vaccine-who/world-health-organization-lists-pfizer-biontech-vaccine-for-emergency-use-idUSL8N2JB2O9 (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Post-Brexit United Kingdom relations with the European Union]], [[Trade negotiation between the UK and the EU]]
**The [[EU–UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement]] enters into force at 23:00 [[Greenwich Mean Time|GMT]], formally ending the [[Brexit withdrawal agreement|Brexit transition period]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-55493437 (BBC News)] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/brexit-trade-deal-legislation-b1780589.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Spain–United Kingdom relations]], [[Effect of Brexit on Gibraltar]]
**[[Spain]] and the United Kingdom reach an agreement to keep [[Gibraltar]] in the [[European Union]]'s [[Schengen Area]] as [[freedom of movement]] between the EU and UK is due to end. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/dec/31/spain-and-uk-reach-draft-deal-on-post-brexit-status-of-gibraltar (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]], [[Grafton vaccine incident]]
***A [[Wisconsin]] pharmacist is arrested after destroying 500 doses of [[Moderna]]'s [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.npr.org/2020/12/31/952536531/pharmacist-arrested-accused-of-destroying-more-than-500-moderna-vaccine-doses (NPR)]
*[[2020–2021 United States racial unrest]], [[Killing of Dolal Idd|Dolal Idd protests]]
**The authorities arrested dozens of protesters in [[Minneapolis]] as they demanded answers into the fatal police shooting of 23-year-old Dolal Bayle Idd on December 30. The protests came after the [[body camera]] footage from a deadly traffic stop was released. At least 15 people were detained for allegedly [[riot]]ing and 21 people were cited and released. [https://kstp.com/news/protesters-demand-answers-in-minneapolis-shooting-dozens-arrested/5965348/?cat=1 (KSTP-TV)]
*[[2020 Hong Kong national security law|Hong Kong national security law]]
**The [[Court of Final Appeal (Hong Kong)|Court of Final Appeal of Hong Kong]] orders [[Pro-democracy camp (Hong Kong)|pro-democracy]] media tycoon [[Jimmy Lai]] to return to prison on [[national security]] law grounds, after a ruling by a lower court released him on bail. [[Chinese state media]] had labeled Lai's release as "unbelievable". [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-12-31/hong-kong-s-top-court-orders-tycoon-jimmy-lai-returned-to-jail (Bloomberg)]
*[[2020 Malian coup d'état]]
**Authorities in [[Mali]] charge six people, including former [[List of prime ministers of Mali|prime minister]] [[Boubou Cissé]], with an "attempted coup". [https://www.barrons.com/news/mali-charges-six-prominent-figures-with-attempted-coup-lawyers-01609436105?tesla=y (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia (U.S. state)|COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia]], [[2020–21 United States Senate election in Georgia]]
****[[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[David Perdue]] and his wife test negative for COVID-19, but will quarantine ahead of his upcoming [[2020–21 United States Senate election in Georgia|runoff]] matchup against [[Jon Ossoff]] after coming into contact with a person in his campaign who later tested positive for the virus. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/david-perdue-covid-contact-in-quarantine/ (CBS News)] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***[[Ontario]] [[Ministry of Finance (Ontario)|Finance Minister]] [[Rod Phillips (politician)|Rod Phillips]] resigns following his trip to [[Saint Barthélemy]] while the province was in a lockdown. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55503789 (BBC News)]
*[[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] suggests that the [[Belarus|country]] would hold a referendum on [[Constitution of Belarus|constitutional]] reforms. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/31/belarus-to-hold-referendum-on-constitutional-changes (Al Jazeera)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Formula One]] champion [[Lewis Hamilton]] is [[knighthood|knighted]] by [[Queen regnant|Queen]] [[Elizabeth II]]. [https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article.arise-sir-lewis-hamilton-to-be-awarded-knighthood-after-historic-seventh.2oKynH8fOmJytSk8mOo0o9.html (Formula One)]
